summary: Fixed Page 2 TIN/Taxpayer Name comb collision by splitting p2c5 into p2c5a..p2c5e and rewiring writer-cells.json (verified between matched before/print-p2.png and after/print-p2.png). Re-captured matched BEFORE and AFTER from the same saved draft with real catalog ATCs (DS101, DS102, DS103) so Schedule 1 Tax Rate (P2.00/P200, P1.50/P200, 75%) and Tax Due print cleanly in all 3 rows, and with Schedule 1 Row 1 open (screen-05b-*-row-open.png). Open-row captures confirm the UI row drawer already displays official column headings (ATC, Tax Base, Tax Rate, Tax Due) from forms/schema-overrides.json; the 64 label updates in forms/forms-schema.json clean the underlying schema data rather than a visible UI change.

defects.where: Page 2 top bar (TIN and Taxpayer's Name, p2c5)
defects.what: Split p2c5 into p2c5a..p2c5d (14 TIN comb slots wired to frm2000:txtPg2TIN1..3 and txtPg2BranchCode) and p2c5e (26 Taxpayer's Name slots wired to frm2000:txtPg2TaxpayerName), eliminating TIN+Name concatenation when the name overflows 26 characters.

defects.where: Page 2 Schedule 1 Tax Rate column (p2c15, p2c23, p2c31)
defects.what: Schedule 1 Tax Rate was blank in the first capture only because raw ATC strings without catalog descriptions were filled; with catalog picks (DS101, DS102, DS103), Tax Rate (P2.00/P200, P1.50/P200, 75%) and Tax Due print cleanly in all 3 rows.

defects.where: Page 1 Items 6, 7, 10, 12 and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name
defects.what: Long taxpayer name, address, line of business, Other Party name, and Page 2 Taxpayer's Name switch out of comb mode and collide with comb ticks.
Official BIR 2000 Page 2 DST/ATC reference table (DS 101..DS 130) is intentionally lifted off the printed sheet into html-frozen/2000-dst-2018/guide.html by tools/formgen/guides.py.

defects.where: Schedules 1-4 in forms/forms-schema.json (64 entries including row templates)
defects.what: 64 schedule field labels in forms/forms-schema.json had raw cell IDs (e.g. sched1:txtTaxBase0). Cleaned to official BIR headings in forms/forms-schema.json. Open-row BEFORE/AFTER captures (screen-05b-*-row-open.png) confirm the UI row drawer already used clean official headings from forms/schema-overrides.json, so the screen screenshots are unchanged.
Reads 'Page 1' under 'January 2018 (ENCS)' on Page 2; matches the official BIR 2000 PDF verbatim (the official BIR PDF itself has this typo).
